experiment: Exp7 -- Paired Bootstrap/Permutation Test: LSTM vs. Tuned LR
description: Attention-LSTM Full Model (3 seeds, ensemble-averaged test probabilities) vs. tuned logistic regression Full Model on the identical test set (n=2035, 2023-01 onward). Paired bootstrap (B=10000, resampling test sequences with replacement) and paired permutation test (P=10000, randomly swapping which model's prediction is used per test sequence) on the AUPRC difference.
